title: Branches, loops and **sub-processes**
sub: CHOICE · FORK / JOIN · forEach · repeat · loopBack · PROCESS
choice.n3: `XOR` join — goes on with the branch that was taken
fork.n1: `FORK` — every branch, at the same time
fork.n2: `AND` join — waits for all of them
fork.n3: `forEach` over a **named** `PROCESS` — one run per room, labelled
fork.n4: `continue` — a failed room does not stop the others
loops.n2: `loopBack` — back to an earlier step, at most `maxIterations`
inline.n2: inline — `steps:` where it is used · versioned with the parent · never started alone
race.n3: each booking `compensable` — a DELETE undoes it
